facts.note: Transcript has the bell striking nine, all watches taken out and inspected, and the narrator's watch two minutes ahead of the bell.

Piquet in the salon until a quarter to eleven by the narrator's watch, then he went to the hall for his cigar case in his coat; the piano began as he went out and stopped when he came back. The transcript names the card partner 'Odile' where the sheet says 'Madame'. Read as the same person, since she is the one playing piquet with him and then the piano, so this is wording, not a changed person.
The hall clock struck eleven a moment after the narrator sat down again.

added.quote: She lifted her hands from the keys and took up her cards again.
added.why: After the narrator came back, Odile was at the card table again, so her whereabouts and a movement are placed after his return, a moment the sheet does not cover.
